name: Transport
description: How people travel: from sailing ships, canals and the first railways to cars, aeroplanes, jets, high-speed trains and electric cars.

checkpoints.name: Sail and canals
checkpoints.note: Sailing ships cross the oceans and canals carry goods inland. Roads are slow and travel is by horse.

checkpoints.name: Steam and balloons
checkpoints.note: The first people fly in a balloon. Steamships cross the Atlantic, Stephenson's railways spread across the world, the Suez Canal opens and London builds the first underground railway.

checkpoints.name: The first cars and aeroplanes
checkpoints.note: Benz builds the first car and the Wright brothers fly in 1903. Ford's Model T makes cars cheap, the Panama Canal opens and the Titanic sinks.

checkpoints.name: Cars for everyone and the jet
checkpoints.note: Motorways spread, the jet engine is invented and airliners cross the oceans. The shipping container changes trade.

checkpoints.name: Jumbo jets and high-speed trains
checkpoints.note: Japan's bullet train opens in 1964. The Boeing 747 and Concorde fly, the TGV and the Channel Tunnel link Europe, and the first hybrid cars appear.

checkpoints.name: Electric and autonomous
checkpoints.note: Tesla makes electric cars popular, China builds the largest high-speed rail network and self-driving taxis start carrying passengers.
